summary: Kimi Antonelli swept to victory at the United States Grand Prix, leading from start to finish while his Mercedes team managed the gap to Ferrari's Charles Leclerc behind him. Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff described the drive as "the race of a champion who isn't the champion yet," highlighting Antonelli's composed execution across the 56 laps. With just two points needed to mathematically secure his first world title, Antonelli heads into the final rounds with an unassailable advantage in the championship standings.
